pillar: 1 — Strategy and planning (also 10 — launches, 18 — promo calendar read)
intents: I have this budget and a launch date — what do I run, where?
plan my launch / drop / Black Friday push
how should I split my budget?
plan next month / replan the budget
we sold out / CAC blew up — what do we change?
reads: brand brain: summary, kit, products, learnings log, onboarding, competitors (brand_read)

claims through the shared claims-gate atom (the sign-off contract: its scoped sign-off, or earlier records by learn-my-brand, unreleased); server scope check for concept proof (knowledge_search claim + product_id)

voice-of-customer bank and buyer groups (research/audience/voc-bank.md, buyer-groups.md or brand documents) — research-audience; demand read and market report (research/market/demand.md, <date>-read.md) — research-market
angle bank, landscape, competitor files (research/competitors/*.md or documents) and competitor roster (competitor_read) — research-competitors
existing campaigns, concepts and pending creative plans (campaign_read, ads_creative_read approvals)
weekly and monthly performance reads (reports/performance/) — analyze-performance, replan mode
change log (ads/campaigns/<slug>/decisions.md ### dated blocks, incl. the server's Meta outcomes) and fired triggers (state.md) — run-paid-campaigns, replan mode
human: goal, budget, date, baseline, margin/ARPA, repeat, stock or capacity, list size, creative capacity, founder hours, tracking state, type-specific items
creator roster creators/roster.csv (wave results) — work-with-creators, when a creator leg is Run/Test
its own last run record runs/plan-campaign/campaign-plan/<slug>/<date>.md (the plan's bets) — run-memory

analyze-performance's run records (runs/analyze-performance/weekly-performance-read/, monthly-read/) and run-paid-campaigns' run records (runs/run-paid-campaigns/weekly-ads-check/<slug>/) — scorecards, money moves, verdicts
Brand Brain (brain_map, brain_open, brain_search where listed): chapters 2, 3, 5, 15, 18, 19, 20 (target_cpa, target_roas, decision.*, experiment.*), 23 (experiment_readout.*, worn_out_angle.*)
writes: readable campaign plan gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-campaign-plan.md (local file, via write-report) — the marketer
brand copy plans/<slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-plan-v<N>.md + document 'Campaign plan — <Brand> — <date> v<N>' (save-to-brain, supersede) — the marketer, any host

campaign record (campaign_upsert): brief_md with fixed headings — economics box, goal chain, channel decisions, budget split, paid structure, test plan, angles, calendar, asset list, measurement plan, hand-offs, replan triggers; read by run-paid-campaigns, analyze-performance, make-static-ads, make-content, email-lifecycle, run-organic-social, work-with-creators
campaign concepts (add_campaign_concept / update_campaign_concept) — read by make-static-ads
optional monthly replan schedule (automation_upsert) — only on the human's explicit yes
draft brief for an approved live campaign: plans/<slug>/draft-v<N>.md (workspace) until the human's yes
run record runs/plan-campaign/campaign-plan/<slug>/<date>.md + brand document (keep-history) — the plan's bets with owner, read date and test — read by its next replan
on approval only: kind 20 target_cpa / target_roas, experiment.<slug>-t<n>, decision.<slug>-<yyyy-mm>-<n> via save-learning's fact path — wait for the marketer's yes
plans/method/ (copied method for the scheduled worker) — read by the monthly replan automation

local mode: the plan in plans/<slug>/ (in place of the campaign record), brand-notes.md and run records under gooseworks-local/<brand-slug>/ — read by its own next replan, run-paid-campaigns and analyze-performance in local mode

needs.gooseworks: optional — without it, local mode (the marketing-guide skill, ../marketing-guide/SKILL.md §5): the live site, the marketer's answers and connectors the marketer has (read-only)
connectors_optional: ads-platform, store, CRM, billing or product-analytics connector (read-only)
